vertical.up: 000 keeps a broad frontal face with high irises, lifted chin, and more visible neck/collar underside.
vertical.down: 180 keeps a broad frontal face with low irises, lowered lids, a tucked chin, and less visible neck.
vertical.independence: The vertical endpoints remain broadly frontal, so the up/down evidence is not borrowed from a horizontal profile turn.

horizontal.right: 090 places nose, pupil, chin, and facial surface on the image-right side of the head center, with rear hair mass behind them.
horizontal.left: 270 places the same landmarks on the image-left side of the head center and is visibly opposite to 090.
horizontal.independence: The left/right endpoints retain comparable height while reversing facial projection, so the horizontal evidence is distinct from chin elevation.

continuity: All 16 frames form a clockwise loop: up to image-right to down to image-left and back toward up. Feet and lower body remain registered, while ears, long hair, mechanical arm with red cord, teal sleeve, and katana remain attached and on their established sides.
